stock.description: Pacific Textiles Holdings Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and global distribution of textile products, performing key processes such as knitting, dyeing, printing, and fabric finishing. Its high-quality fabrics are integral to a variety of apparel, including men's, women's, and children's garments, alongside specialized items like sportswear, swimwear, and intimate apparel. The firm also provides information technology services. Operating globally, its extensive footprint covers Hong Kong, mainland China, Vietnam, Bangladesh, the United States, Jordan, Indonesia, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, India, Haiti, various other Asian nations, African territories, and other international markets. Founded in 1997, Pacific Textiles Holdings Limited has its headquarters in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
